pages.text: $(d)Regular Coils$()$(br2)$(d)Spectre Coils$() allow you to extract energy from your $(l:irregular_implements:blocks/spectre_energy_injector)Spectre Energy Buffer$(/l) wirelessly.$(br2)Each tier pulls a higher RF/t. Place the Coil directly on the machine you want to charge.

$(d)Generator Coils$()$(br2)The $(d)Spectre Coil Nr. 245$() generates a small amount of RF/t for free, rather than using your Spectre Energy Buffer. It can be rarely found in dungeon chests.$(br2)The $(d)Genesis Spectre Coil$() is creative-only, and generates an infinite amount of RF/t.
